_comment: Built-in defaults per network. These are overridable per-key from .env (see .env.example)
— .env wins, so a developer pointing at a local LWS never has to edit this file.
EVERY network here ships in EVERY build: the chain is a runtime, per-wallet choice.
BDX_NETWORK / --env network=... only pick which one a fresh wallet starts on.
There is deliberately no `hosts` list here: webpack derives the manifest's host_permissions
from the union of the resolved URLs below (origin, port stripped — Chrome match patterns
forbid ports), so an endpoint change can never leave the extension without permission to
fetch it, and switching chains can never land on an ungranted host.
Address prefixes are NOT here — they are consensus constants, and live beside the encoder
